description.en: Grimm collects the fairy tales people grow up with. He has summoned you to help when their stories go wrong. Learn skills, find companions, and set out. Later content still uses original names.
description.zh-CN: 格林收集着各国陪伴人们长大的童话。故事出了乱子，他召唤你前来帮忙。学习本领、结识伙伴，再出发。后续内容暂沿用原版。

description.en: Grimm sits with a book, thinking over the stories he has collected.
description.zh-CN: 格林坐在屋内，翻看着收集来的故事，似乎正在思索什么。

description.en: Grimm is still reading where you left him. There is always another story to discuss.
description.zh-CN: 你回到格林的居所。他仍在翻阅故事册，等着听你旅途上的见闻。

guideLocation.en: The collector of stories needs your help.
guideLocation.zh-CN: 收集故事的格林有事想请你帮忙。

houseLocation.en: Grimm's home. Speak with him or continue your preparations.
houseLocation.zh-CN: 格林的居所，可以向他请教，或继续准备旅程。

tutorial.en: Ask Grimm about leaving the village
tutorial.zh-CN: 找格林出村，接下买药教学

team.en: Return to Grimm's home for team practice
team.zh-CN: 回格林居所完成结伴练习

en: Where am I?
zh-CN: 这是哪里？

en: You have learned the basics. Let us see what awaits beyond the village.
zh-CN: 基础学得差不多了。来，看看村外的旅程吧。

en: Your choices matter. The way you treat people changes how this world sees you.
You can help, deceive, forgive or fight. Choose carefully; the people in these stories will remember.
zh-CN: 你的选择会影响这个世界对你的看法。怎样对待别人，就会留下怎样的评价。
帮助、欺骗、原谅或战斗，都由你来选。故事里的人，会记得你的决定。

en: Most companions join after you help them through their own story.
The route you choose can change who will travel with you.
Finishing a journey may also reveal a companion for the next round.
You can look for experienced travellers at the inn, too.
Explore, listen, and earn people's trust. You will not have to travel alone.
zh-CN: 大多数伙伴，需要你帮助他们走过一段故事，才愿意加入。
不同的选择，也会影响谁愿意与你同行。
完成一个周目后，下一段旅程还可能遇到特别的开局伙伴。
旅馆里也有一些经验丰富的旅人，可以去看看。
多走走，多听听，赢得别人的信任，就能结识可靠的同行者。

en: I have collected stories of travellers who began with very little.
They learned, found companions, and eventually chose a road of their own.
Their journeys are worth remembering, but they do not decide yours.
You need not repeat anyone else's story. Let us see what you make of this one.
That sounds better than being told my ending in advance.
zh-CN: 我收集过不少旅人的故事。他们出发时，也未必比你准备得更多。
他们学习本领、结识伙伴，最后选了自己的路。
那些故事值得记下，但不能替你决定这一回的旅程。
你不必照着谁的结局走。这次，看看你会怎样写下去。
那还不错，至少不用一开始就被安排好结局。

en: What should I keep in mind on this journey?
Help the people whose stories have stopped. Learn their skills, earn their trust, and return when you have something to tell me.
One story at a time. I can do that.
zh-CN: 这趟旅程，我最该记住什么？
帮助那些故事停在半途的人。学习本领，赢得信任，有了新的见闻，再回来讲给我听。
一段一段来。我记住了。

en: Could I practise by challenging you?
Start with the village instructor. My books are not much use as shields.
Fair enough. I will find the instructor.
zh-CN: 要不，先找你练练手？
还是先去找武师吧。我这些书，可不适合拿来当盾牌。
好吧，我找武师去。

choicePrompt.en: What would you like to know?

en: [Leave the village] I am ready for the road.
[Leave] Nothing else for now.
[Ask] Do my choices matter?
[Ask] How can I recruit companions?
[Ask] Tell me about the travellers before me.
[Ask] What is my goal?
[Challenge] Can I practise with you?
zh-CN: 【结束新手村】我准备好了，出村吧。
【离开】暂时没事了。
【询问】我的选择会有什么影响？
【询问】怎样结识同行的伙伴？
【询问】你还收集过哪些旅人的故事？
【询问】我这次旅程的目标是什么？
【挑战】能找你练练手吗？

点击人物头像，即可触发与人物交互。.en: Select Grimm's portrait to speak with him.
点击人物头像，即可触发与人物交互。.zh-CN: 点击格林的头像，就能与他交谈。

再次来到金庸十四天书的世界。.en: Grimm summoned me to help the people whose fairy tales have come to a halt.
再次来到金庸十四天书的世界。.zh-CN: 格林召唤我前来，帮助那些童话停在半途的人。

点击人物状态栏，点击修炼，可以装备内功入门。.en: Open 修炼 (Cultivation) and select 内功入门 to begin training.
点击人物状态栏，点击修炼，可以装备内功入门。.zh-CN: 打开人物状态栏的修炼，选择内功入门，开始练习。

装备上的武学经书，在战斗结束后能将获得的经验快速分配到该项武学上，可以迅速提升武.en: A selected training manual receives experience after battle and improves its skill.
装备上的武学经书，在战斗结束后能将获得的经验快速分配到该项武学上，可以迅速提升武.zh-CN: 选入修炼栏的秘籍，会在战斗结束后获得经验，提升对应本领。

text.en: I'm Grimm. I collect the fairy tales people grow up with, from lands around the world.
text.zh-CN: 我是格林，一直在收集各国那些陪伴人们长大的童话。
是你把我召唤到这里的？

text.en: Yes. Something has gone wrong, and some of their stories have come to a halt.
text.zh-CN: 是的。故事出了乱子，有些人的故事停在了半途。

text.en: Will you enter the tales, find those people, and help their stories continue?
text.zh-CN: 我想请你走进童话，找到他们，帮他们把故事继续下去。

text.en: I'll help. Where do I start?
text.zh-CN: 好，我来帮你。从哪里开始？

text.en: Learn the basics in the village. Then set out and find companions.
text.zh-CN: 先在村里学些本领，出村后再结识伙伴，一起上路吧。

text.en: Take this beginner's manual, 内功入门. Select it for training, then practise with the village instructor.
text.zh-CN: 这本内功入门给你，先选入修炼栏，再找村里的武师练练。

text.en: Understood. I'll get ready before I set out.
text.zh-CN: 明白，我先做好准备再上路。
